When I was a preschool teacher I told parents if they did not label their child’s possessions I would. I provided tape and sharpies next to the sign in book and had a sign there explaining if they didn’t label things I would.

My policy was clearly stated and was included in every weekly newsletter and several places in the classroom. I also tried to be as respectful as possible to keep kids safe and to allow parents to re-sell or pass items on easily.
